contents.text: How many people did Microsoft employ, and where?

As of June 30, 2026, Microsoft employed approximately 223,000 people on a full-time basis, with 121,000 in the U.S. and 102,000 internationally. (Source: MSFT-10K-2026.html, PART I > Item 1. BUSINESS)
